summary: Restated the seven child questions' discriminators — which still described the plans they were registered with — as the observations that actually carried each answer, each naming its receipt and indices: the pre-vote delivered before, after and after-restore around the forged message with the quorum stream completing at term 3; the new leader's first append accepted by the deposed incumbent at the committed prefix; the three-round persistence loop with its control round, its three grants and its working repair; the three Node.Step deliveries read back through Status; the silent-leader samples at the first and second election timeouts; the queued read request released with the commit index at release time; and the demoted-then-re-elected node releasing the stale request with the later index. Only the discriminators changed, validation passed with no execution requested, and the account itself is untouched: one finding asserted with receipts and a reproduction, every question in the index now carrying its own interpretation, severity bounded by measured observations, and the remaining limits scope-only.
